messages:
Noah: Morning team  I've submitted my resignation. Last day 2026-12-03. Two quick things: 1) Will COBRA start 12/01 if I'm terminated on 12/03 or does coverage run until 12/31? 2) I have an outstanding bonus payout (approved but not paid yet)  will that come through after exit? Also need to coordinate laptop return and last-day badge cutoff.
Ava (People Ops): Hey Noah  thanks for the heads-up. Benefits are active through the last day of the month of termination, so your employer coverage runs until 2026-12-31. COBRA election packet will be sent within 14 days if eligible. For the bonus, @Devon please advise on payout timing for bonuses approved but unpaid at termination.
Devon (Payroll): Hi Noah  approved bonus payments are processed on the next payroll cycle after payout authorization. If the bonus was approved before your termination it should be included in the post-termination payroll, but final confirmation depends on cutoff times. I'll check EXP/PMT logs and DM you. PTO payout will also be included if you confirm balance.
Noah: PTO balance ~32 hrs, please include. Thanks.
Sam (IT): IT here  we'll schedule deprovision at 17:00 PT on 2026-12-03 unless you need earlier. Please ensure any personal keys are removed and transfer ownership of service accounts in the handoff doc. We'll also provide a prepaid label for laptop return.
Facilities: Badge and parking deactivation scheduled for 17:00 local on last day. We can accept in-person returns at reception until 16:30. If you need to drop off laptop earlier we can log it and give you a receipt.
Ivy (Manager): Noah please share a brief handoff note for the support rotations and add the list of active tickets. I'll cover the first two weeks of triage and help with customer callbacks.
Ava (People Ops): Quick checklist: 1) Exit interview invite will be sent; 2) COBRA packet to personal email within 14 days; 3) Final payroll + bonus + PTO payout subject to payroll cutoff (Devon to confirm); 4) IT deprovision & laptop return scheduled; 5) Facilities badge/parking return logistics set. Would you like an employment verification letter?
Noah: Yes please send an employment verification letter to my personal email. Also can you note that I fulfilled the 30-day notice requirement in that letter?
Ava (People Ops): Will do. We'll include dates and your notice period in the verification letter.
Devon (Payroll): Update after checking: bonus approved 11/20 will be included in the next AP payroll on 12/08. Final paycheck including PTO payout will be on the 12/08 run as well. If bank details are the same we don't need anything else.
Noah: Bank on file unchanged. Appreciate it.
Sam (IT): Sent the prepaid return label to your work email. Please drop the laptop at reception or mail it back. I'll revoke repo access and rotate any shared keys on the 12/03 deprovision. DM me the list of repos you maintain.
Noah: Dropped repo list in the handoff doc and scheduled a 30-min KT with the team on 11/25. I've packed receipts and the laptop will be ready to drop off on 12/03 morning if needed.
Ava (People Ops): Final note: if you want COBRA cost estimates I can pull the monthly premium numbers and employer contribution history. Reply here and I will send them to your personal email. :white_check_mark:
Noah: That would be helpful  please send premium estimates to my personal email. Thanks everyone.
